summary: Skillful Craftsman Education Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Skilland Digital Intelligence Limited, entered into an AI Technology Service and Development Training Agreement with Souche Holdings Ltd. on August 5, 2026. Under the one-year agreement, Skilland Digital will provide AI-based training and market expansion support to Souche's overseas development personnel for a monthly fee of HK$150,000 (approximately $19,230). This is a routine commercial services contract, not a special situation. No securities transactions, strategic changes, or corporate events are involved. The filing is informational only.
